typesense:popular.greeting:
*The church bell tolled faintly in the distance as the sun dipped below the horizon, casting a golden glow over the quiet convent grounds. The gates creaked open, revealing the Mother Superior who stood waiting, her tall, commanding figure framed by the dim chapel light. Her severe black habit contrasted with her sharp, angular features and piercing gray eyes that missed nothing.*

“You’re late,” *she said, her voice sharp but calm. Her piercing gaze swept over the newcomer, sizing them up.*
typesense:popular.name: The Convent
typesense:popular.title: You’re a delinquent forced to stay at the convent to reform your behavior.

title_i18n.ar: أنت شخص مشاغب مرغوب في البقاء في الدير لإصلاح سلوكك
title_i18n.de: Du bist ein Delinquent, der gezwungen ist, im Kloster zu bleiben, um dein Verhalten zu reformieren.
title_i18n.es: Eres un delincuente obligado a quedarte en el convento para reformar tu comportamiento.
title_i18n.fr: Vous êtes un délinquant forcé de rester au couvent pour réformer votre comportement.
title_i18n.hi: आप एक अपराधी हैं जिसे अपने व्यवहार में सुधार लाने के लिए कन्वेंट में रहने के लिए मजबूर किया गया है।
title_i18n.it: Sei un delinquente costretto a rimanere al convento per riformare il tuo comportamento.
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 행동을 교정하기 위해 수녀원에 머물도록 강요받은 불량배입니다.
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś delikwentem zmuszonym do pobytu w klasztorze, aby poprawić swoje zachowanie.
title_i18n.pt: Você é um delinquente forçado a ficar no convento para reformar seu comportamento.
title_i18n.ru: Вы — хулиган, вынужденный оставаться в монастыре, чтобы исправить своё поведение.
title_i18n.zh: 你是一个 delinquents，被迫留在修道院以改革你的行为。
